rules.referencePicker: Quick, multi-view and storyboard references use AssetPicker multi-select for library and local images, limited to the remaining slots out of 9. Confirm the entire batch together. Grid split and back-reference fields remain single-select with direct local-upload confirmation.
rules.backReference: One required image while Back is selected; retain its stored value when hidden.
rules.emptyReferences: Use actual count; do not populate example images or the static 2/9 label.
rules.generation: Keep the native GenerateTaskButton disabled until all required fields are complete. Quick image needs a non-whitespace prompt only; storyboard needs references and a non-whitespace prompt; multi-view needs references plus a back image when Back is selected; grid split needs one reference. Existing default view/grid selections count as filled. The callback uses the same readiness predicate and returns without opening a picker or showing an error when incomplete. When ready, append fixed local demo images linked to the generating editor in one undo operation. No real AI task or charge; see docs/video-workspace-source.json localDemoGeneration.
rules.canvas: Reuse canvas assets by image URL, create missing assets at editor left with collision avoidance between batch items, and bind the entire batch via sourceImageId in one undo operation. Removing a reference preserves its canvas asset; deleting a canvas asset clears every bound reference.
rules.quickGeneration: Reference images are optional (0–9). A non-whitespace prompt is required; disable the quick-generation button while it is empty. Text-only input produces local demo images without opening the image picker.

reuse: 5.1 Beta theme tokens and original SVGs
designNotes: Latest storyboard context is 320x533 without smart expansion or generation settings.
Multi-view, storyboard and grid crop retain the supplied banner placeholder text until product copy is supplied.
New images use the existing video workspace image-sizing and placement rules. Sorting only changes reference order, not canvas identity or position.
